name: ngraph.serialization

name: @statelyai/graph
scope: Matrix Market graph vertices, edges, and edge weight

name: @jtgtools/xsparse
scope: Coordinate real matrix dimensions and value

name: bakana
input_api: await initialize(); new TenxMatrixMarketDataset(matrixFile, featureFile, barcodeFile).load()
scope: 10x Matrix Market matrix and companion feature/barcode files
family_note: bakana delegates Matrix Market parsing to scran.js; this is a separate npm package path but not a distinct parser engine.

name: @orbifold/graphs
scope: Graph edges from no-comment coordinate real general input
family_note: The published parser misparses a valid comment-bearing control; verified scope is limited to the no-comment control.

name: @msagl/parser
input_api: parseTXT(localText) after bundling the published ESM entry with esbuild 0.25.12
scope: Graph edges from coordinate real general input; weights ignored
family_note: The published ESM entry uses extensionless imports; the adapter bundles the pinned package without source changes. parseTXT explicitly handles Matrix Market percent comments and the size header, but ignores entry weights.

name: keepset
input_api: fetchEntry(dataset, { fetch: documented FetchPort returning a Response over local file bytes }); graph/v1 result
scope: Coordinate real general matrix interpreted as a bipartite graph; three entries become edges and numeric values are not returned
family: keepset native Matrix Market graph parser
family_note: The package internally dispatches its matrix-market recipe to its own parser. The adapter supplies local bytes through the documented injectable FetchPort; no remote service is used.
